reviewed_sources.disposition: Inspect whole-command snapshot download. No typed metadata/data decoding or individual call accounting is exposed; no command or backend implementation is imported.
Inspect download executor result boundary; unit success is not adopted as independently qualified complete IC transfer.
Trace download transition, receipt and local interruption reconciliation. These consumers and directory-to-completion assumptions remain unchanged and are not imported.

pinned_upstream.shape: Preserve pinned optional source/global slots and optional timer/hook values; required source/global wire forms also admit. No absent value becomes an upload default.
pinned_upstream.license: Registry dependency; no upstream or Canic source copied. Existing source provenance and licenses retained.

adaptation.implemented: Ephemeral exact metadata request and bounded read-only metadata reply; safe bounded sequence visitors, actual reserved source marker, ordered values/absence, exact raw evidence.
adaptation.not_adopted: Provider, signing, runtime/ICP imports, fresh read-permission port, persisted transfer records, extents, upload/load/start, automatic outcomes or runner completion.
adaptation.compatibility: Additive public module; existing exhaustive method/error enums, six-method v1 request schema, arguments, hashes, journals and package versions unchanged.

qualification.membership: Registered case lists are compared with actual passing names; golden fixture membership is read from the JSON registry, not a remembered count.
qualification.native: Local wire/identity/bounds/persistence tests only. No fake or actual IC backend effects.
qualification.remaining: Authenticated snapshot association, fresh reads and per-call authority, data/extent/transfer/upload completeness, application/byte/command custody and terminal/release admission.
